content.user_title: Align Project Decisions With Your Expectations
content.value_statement: Unclear goals and changing priorities can make agent decisions diverge from your expectations. Align captures confirmed criteria in ALIGN.md and reviews meaningful changes against them.
actual_capabilities: Review existing agreements, relevant project documentation, conversation context, and available Git history.
Ask one to three focused questions about consequential gaps in goals, priorities, constraints, and autonomy.
Draft a concise agreement that separates requirements, preferences, assumptions, and unresolved matters.
Save authorized agreement changes in the project-root ALIGN.md while preserving unrelated content.
Distinguish full confirmation timestamps from partial confirmations and unconfirmed drafts.
Add an ALIGN.md reference to project agent instructions while preserving existing rules and respecting instruction hierarchy.
limitations: Reliable drift review depends on available project context and history; missing evidence must be disclosed.
The skill does not guarantee every agent reads AGENTS.md or invokes alignment on every task.
Lasting agreement changes require confirmation or clear authorization; automatic review does not count as confirmation.
The skill supports one user's alignment with their agents, not a multi-party approval workflow.

use_cases.title: Define a New Project
use_cases.description: Clarify intended users, success criteria, priorities, and exclusions before an agent makes implementation decisions.

use_cases.title: Review Development Drift
use_cases.description: Compare relevant implementation changes with an existing agreement and propose revisions only when new evidence matters.

use_cases.title: Clarify Writing Priorities
use_cases.description: Record audience, quality expectations, constraints, and autonomy boundaries for an ongoing writing project.
use_cases.target_user: Writer working with an AI agent

prompt_templates.title: Start an Agreement
prompt_templates.prompt: Use align to clarify goals for [project]. Ask about the most important gaps, then show a concise draft for my review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: establish direction for a new project.

prompt_templates.title: Align an Existing Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use align for [project]. Review relevant documentation and summarize the current direction. Ask what I want to retain or change before drafting ALIGN.md.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: document expectations for an existing project.

prompt_templates.title: Review Possible Drift
prompt_templates.prompt: Use align to compare [recent changes] with our existing ALIGN.md. Use available history, disclose gaps, and propose revisions only for meaningful inconsistencies.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: evaluate changes against confirmed criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Specific Criterion
prompt_templates.prompt: Use align to update [criterion] to [new requirement]; I authorize this lasting change. Preserve unrelated criteria and the full-confirmation timestamp. Record this partial confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: authorize a scoped change without reconfirming the full agreement.

output_examples.input: Align my appointment-booking project. Prioritize mobile access and keep payments out of the first release.
output: Draft purpose: Let customers book available appointment slots from a phone.
Priority: Mobile usability takes precedence over optional desktop enhancements.
Exclusion: Payment processing is outside the first release.
Open question: What booking completion rate will define success?
Confirmation status: Not yet confirmed; no agreement has been saved.

output_examples.input: Review a payment feature against our confirmed agreement, which excludes payments from the first release.
output: Meaningful drift: The payment feature conflicts with the confirmed first-release exclusion.
Proposed decision: Defer payment work unless you explicitly change the release scope.
The current agreement and full-confirmation timestamp remain unchanged.

output_examples.input: I authorize changing the launch platform from desktop to mobile. Keep all other agreement criteria.
output: Updated ALIGN.md: Launch platform is now mobile; unrelated criteria remain unchanged.
Recorded partial confirmation on the launch-platform criterion.
The full-alignment timestamp remains unchanged because this was not a full reconfirmation.

best_practices: Identify the target project and provide existing agreements, relevant documentation, and available history.
State concrete priorities, exclusions, and autonomy boundaries when important values conflict.
Confirm lasting changes explicitly and distinguish partial updates from full agreement confirmation.
anti_patterns: Treating implementation choices or inferred preferences as confirmed user requirements.
Repeating a full interview when routine work already fits the current agreement.
Advancing the full-confirmation timestamp after automatic review or a partial change.

faq.question: What does align produce?
faq.answer: It drafts or updates a concise ALIGN.md agreement covering goals, success criteria, scope, priorities, constraints, and relevant unresolved matters.

faq.question: Which AI tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Actual instruction loading depends on the target agent and its project configuration.

faq.question: Does the project need Git?
faq.answer: No. Git history helps review changes, but the skill must disclose missing history and must not initialize Git without a request.

faq.question: When does the skill save an agreement?
faq.answer: It saves after you confirm the draft or clearly authorize the particular lasting changes. Explicit delegation may authorize saving an unconfirmed draft.

faq.question: Will every future agent enforce ALIGN.md automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill adds a project instruction reference, but agent compatibility varies. It prohibits silent hook installation and global setting changes.

faq.question: How are partial confirmations recorded?
faq.answer: Only affected criteria receive updated confirmation times. The full-alignment timestamp changes only when you confirm the complete agreement.
